description: Checks that a data-rendering screen shows exactly what its source returns. For each screen that renders rows from an API or a store, compares the rendered rows against a fresh, read-only fetch of the response behind them, field by field, and renders a page — one row table per view, mismatches first — showing where they agree and where they do not.
